description: A dataset's variables or properties (standard names, units, categories, bands, aggregates), horizon, step, cadence, freshness, cost class, verified `examples` and an example_query to read its values; a map layer's axes (source, region, product facts) and render (visual) call. Free; call it after search_data, before get_data. Example: {"dataset_id": "<from search_data>"}.

dataset_id.description: A dataset id from search_data or get_data (1-80 characters).

name: describe_data

attribution.description: Attribution the dataset licence requires. Cite it when quoting these values.

data_status.description: Present only when the data service could not answer: a cached copy, or catalog facts without freshness.

example_query.description: get_data arguments for this dataset; add a location.

map.description: A map layer: its axes, sibling sectors, `select` (its id and its <family>:<pick>), the render (visual) call, and a note.

title: Describe data
